docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $7,000.00 FILED BY ALEXANDER, YOLANDA AS TO DEFENDANT PUBLIC STORAGE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-25-2021 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
COPYING FEES (5 PAGE) PAID BY PLAINTIFF ALEXANDER, YOLANDA
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF ALEXANDER, YOLANDA AS TO DEFENDANT PUBLIC STORAGE

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-25-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO APR-21-2021 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF YOLANDA ALEXANDER IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT PUBLIC STORAGE IS NOT PRESENT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE FOR PROOF OF SERVICE. MATTER CONTINUED TO APRIL 21, 2021 AT 8:30 A.M. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT)
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - SIGNED SERVED MAR-02-2021, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT PUBLIC STORAGE

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF YOLANDA ALEXANDER IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT PUBLIC STORAGE IS NOT PRESENT. ROBERT ISLA, DISTRICT MANAGER FOR EXTRA SPACE STORAGE IS PRESENT IN COURT. EXTRA SPACE STORAGE IS NOT A NAMED PARTY IN THIS CASE. MR. ISLA STATES THAT HE APPEARED TODAY BECAUSE THE CLAIM FOR DEFENDANT PUBLIC STORAGE WAS SERVED AT THE ADDRESS FOR EXTRA SPACE STORAGE. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
REMARK: RETURN MAIL-5/10/21-ORDER OF DISMISSAL SENT TO PUBLIC STORAGE-NOT DELIVERABLE AS ADDRESSED/UNABLE TO FORWARD
ORDER RE: DISMISSAL WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NO APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF.
